senses.gloss: कृच्छ्र- + अब्द कृच्छ्र- + अब्द, m. a year of penance, Man. 11, 162.

कृच्छ्र कृच्छ्र (probably from an old pres. base कृच्छ of the vb. कृष्; cf. e. g. इष्, pr. base इच्छ),
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Painful, Rām. 3, 74, 29.
 2. Difficult, Rām. 3, 46, 16.
 3. Dangerous, Suśr. 1, 131, 4.
 4. Wicked, Man. 6, 78.
 5. Miserable, MBh. 3, 15388.
 II. n. and m.
 1. Pain, Bhāg. P. 9, 24, 35.
 2. Difficulty, Rām. 3, 68, 53.
 3. Distress, Bhartṛ. 2, 23.
 4. Penance, Man. 4, 222.
 III. acc. रम्, adverbially, Miserably, Rām. 4, 22, 7. Instr. रेण, adv. With difficulty, Pañc. 137, 25; with much ado, Pañc. 40, 10. Abl. रात्, adv. With difficulty, Rām. 3, 73, 11.
 --Comp.
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र, i. e. कृच्छ्र-अति-, [] m. 1. du. a common and a very severe penance, Man. 11, 208. 2. a particular penance, Yājñ. 3, 321.
कृच्छ्रता कृच्छ्र + ता, f. Dangerousness, Suśr. 2, 138, 20.
कृच्छ्र- + प्राण कृच्छ्र- + प्राण, adj. supporting life with difficulty, Rām. 4, 9, 30.
